# MCP Readiness

> Free, open-source live scanner for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. It connects like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor do and scores OAuth discovery (RFC 9728), tool annotations, Origin/CORS, JSON-RPC conformance, schemas, and the token cost of the tool list on every agent turn. Web scan, public page per server, README badge, CLI, a GitHub Action, and a free live MCP tool (`scan_mcp_server` at https://mcp.pacerai.fit/mcp, no key).

## Use it
- [Scan a public MCP server](https://mcp.pacerai.fit/): paste an https URL, no sign-up, 10 scans/hour.
- [MCP endpoint](https://mcp.pacerai.fit/mcp): free Streamable HTTP server, tool `scan_mcp_server`, no license key.
- [Server pages](https://mcp.pacerai.fit/s/mcp.context7.com/mcp): /s/<host>/<path> shows the latest score, token cost, top issues and the badge.
- [GitHub Action](https://github.com/Om3rr/mcp-readiness-check#readme): fail a PR under a score or over a token budget; works on localhost in CI.
- [CLI](https://github.com/Om3rr/mcp-readiness-cli): scan a remote or stdio MCP server from the terminal.
- [Source (MIT)](https://github.com/Om3rr/mcp-readiness-check)

## Data
- [Popular remote MCP servers, 20 November 2026](https://mcp.pacerai.fit/mcp-servers/): scores and tokens per turn.
- [CI setup guide](https://mcp.pacerai.fit/docs/ci/): badge and GitHub Action in 3 steps, local servers in CI, troubleshooting.
- 23 popular remote MCP servers scanned unauthenticated on 20 November 2026: 8 answer tools/list without login, 15 require OAuth.
- 14 of 15 OAuth-protected servers had no pre-login readiness notes (401, WWW-Authenticate, OAuth protected-resource discovery); spec notes: Atlassian (Uses the older 2025-03-26 discovery (AS metadata on the MCP host, no RFC 9728)).
- Tool-list cost per agent turn ranges from ~80 tokens (Astro Docs) to ~4,967 tokens (Hugging Face) among the open servers.
- 2 of 8 open servers declare no tool annotations (readOnlyHint / destructiveHint); 3 of 8 have at least one tool description that is too long.
- 52 more remote servers scanned on 20 November 2026: 17 open, 35 require login. Heaviest open tool lists: Gmail ~11,282 tokens (23 tools), Google Docs ~10,011 tokens (2 tools), Google Slides ~8,957 tokens (4 tools).
- The long tail is different: see the State of public MCP servers report (official registry scan, 13 Nov 2026), where the longest single tool description was 27,638 characters.

## Blog
- [Blog](https://mcp.pacerai.fit/blog/): guides for shipping MCP servers.
- [The MCP OAuth discovery checklist](https://mcp.pacerai.fit/blog/mcp-oauth-discovery-checklist/): A step-by-step checklist for MCP OAuth: RFC 9728 protected resource metadata, authorization server metadata, the 401 WWW-Authenticate hint, and the legacy 2025-03-26 flow to avoid.
- [MCP server testing tools compared: Inspector, scanners, and CI gates](https://mcp.pacerai.fit/blog/mcp-server-testing-tools-comparison/): A fair comparison of MCP Inspector, hosted security scanners, and CI readiness checks — what each tool actually does, what it does not do, and how to use them together before you ship.
- [How to reduce MCP tool-list token cost](https://mcp.pacerai.fit/blog/reduce-mcp-tool-list-token-cost/): A practical guide to shrinking the tokens an MCP server adds on every agent turn, with live measurements from 8 open popular servers and a CI budget you can enforce.
- [A production-readiness checklist for remote MCP servers](https://mcp.pacerai.fit/blog/remote-mcp-production-readiness-checklist/): A practical checklist for shipping a remote MCP server: Origin validation, OAuth discovery, tool annotations, JSON-RPC errors, and a token budget, with figures from 23 popular servers.
- [How to test an MCP server before shipping (CI with a GitHub Action)](https://mcp.pacerai.fit/blog/test-mcp-server-before-shipping/): A pre-ship test plan for MCP servers: what to check by hand with MCP Inspector, and how to fail a pull request with a free GitHub Action that scores readiness and tool-list token cost.

## Reports
- State of public MCP servers (official registry scan, 13 Nov 2026): 15,067 live servers reached; 44% of public servers accept a foreign Origin.
- [State of public MCP servers, Nov 2026](https://mcp.pacerai.fit/state-of-mcp-2026-11.html): the full registry scan and a checklist for server owners.
